card.name: The hyphen in HLA-B gene names
card.fires_on: The "-B" piece right after "HLA" in HLA-B allele names such as HLA-B*5701 or HLA-B*1502. It appears in genetic-risk warnings for abacavir, carbamazepine and allopurinol.

modes.label: HLA-B allele names
modes.description: The "-B" after HLA, just before the asterisk and allele number.

card.plain: It marks the spot in the gene name HLA-B where an allele number like *5701 comes next.
